resolved.title: malloc函数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The malloc Function[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The allocated memory is [b]contiguous[/b] and can be treated as an [b]array[/b]. Instead of using brackets [ ] to refer to elements, pointer arithmetic is used to traverse the array. You are advised to use + to refer to array elements. Using ++ or += changes the address stored by the pointer.

If the allocation is unsuccessful, [b]NULL[/b] is returned. Because of this, you should include code to check for a NULL pointer.
[note]A simple two-dimensional array requires [b](rows*columns)*sizeof(datatype)[/b] bytes of memory.[/note]

If the allocation is unsuccessful, [b]NULL[/b] is returned. Because of this, you should include code to check for a NULL pointer.
[note]A simple two-dimensional array requires [b](rows*columns)*sizeof(datatype)[/b] bytes of memory.[/note]

content.text:
分配内存是**连续的**，可以作为一个**数组**对待。不使用括号`[ ]`来访问元素，而是使用**指针运算**来遍历数组。建议你使用`+`来迭代数组元素。使用`++`或`+=`可以更改指针所存储的地址。

如果分配不成功，则返回NULL。因此，你应该包含用于检查NULL指针的代码。
content.text_html:
The allocated memory is contiguous and can be treated as an array. Instead of using brackets [ ] to refer to elements, pointer arithmetic is used to traverse the array. You are advised to use + to refer to array elements. Using ++ or += changes the address stored by the pointer.

If the allocation is unsuccessful, NULL is returned. Because of this, you should include code to check for a NULL pointer.

分配的内存是连续的，可以作为一个**数组对待。不使用括号[ ]来指代元素，而是使用指针运算来遍历数组。我们建议你使用+来指代数组元素。使用++或+=可以改变指针所存储的地址。

如果分配不成功，将返回NULL。因为这个原因，你应该包括检查NULL指针的代码。

content.text: 一个简单的二维数组需要 `(rows*columns)*sizeof(datatype)`字节的内存。

A simple two-dimensional array requires **(rowscolumns)sizeof(datatype) bytes of memory.

一个简单的二维数组需要（行列）sizeof（数据类型）字节的内存。
